method: Recursive evaluation of actual saved Blender node/socket links, Math operations, MixRGB and Emission values using Python double precision; no editor recipe imported. The native graph owns UV→toroidal distances/periodic coordinate and phase warps→connected ridges/body→radiance. This tests scalar analytical values, not raster consumer success.
limits: Double precision graph evaluation differs from GPU float arithmetic. Actual native replay and full48 frames separately establish raster behavior. No rendered pixel patch, extra overlap or source mutation.
